name: Spirit Hosts
worldbuilding: Restless ancestors, spectral warriors, wraiths, banshees, and supernatural processions. Their armies pass through terrain and rely on unnatural defenses, fear, and freedom of movement. They do not require conventional mounted cavalry to field mobile battlefield units.

factionRule.name: Incorporeal
factionRule.effect: Friendly Spirit Units gain Ward 6+ against Physical Damage, or their Ward is improved by 1 against incoming Physical damage. This effect is already marked on the faction datasheets and is not applied a second time to those printed Ward values.

factionCommands.name: Fade from Reality
factionCommands.effect: Improve one friendly Unit's applicable Ward by one step until the end of the Phase.

factionCommands.name: Spectral Passage
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit gains Move +2" and may move through terrain and Models during this Movement activation, finishing legally.

factionCommands.name: Haunting Presence
factionCommands.effect: Choose one enemy Unit within Short of the active Unit. Until the end of this Phase, that enemy cannot benefit from Cover or Cover X against Attacks; it loses Evade eligibility that comes solely from Cover, but keeps other sources of Evade. This does not worsen its printed Evade or remove terrain.

factionCommands.name: Haunt the Battleline
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Ranged 4 or Anti-Support 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Incorporeal Advance
abilities.effect: May Move and Charge through terrain and Models but must finish legally.

abilities.name: Terrifying Presence
abilities.effect: Enemies Engaged with this Unit worsen Evade by one step. May Move through terrain, finishing legally.

abilities.name: Keening Wail
abilities.effect: Enemies within Short of this Unit worsen Hit by one step when targeting it with ranged Attacks.

abilities.name: Deathly Escort
abilities.effect: One unengaged friendly Spirit Unit within Short gains Concealed until its next activation or until it becomes Engaged.

abilities.name: Soul Rend
abilities.effect: On 3+, inflict Direct Damage 1 on a visible enemy within Medium.

abilities.name: Funeral Bell
abilities.effect: One visible enemy within Medium cannot benefit from positive Move modifiers or Charge this Round.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Unbound Spirit
abilities.effect: Ignores terrain and Models while moving, finishing legally.

abilities.name: Otherworldly Bulk
abilities.effect: After successfully Charging, enemies cannot use Reactions against its first Melee Attack that Round.

factionLeader.name: Pale Monarch

abilities.name: Royal Terror
abilities.effect: Enemies within Short of the Pale Monarch cannot Evade.

abilities.name: Kingdom of the Dead
abilities.effect: Until the end of the Round, Friendly Units within Short of Pale Monarch gain Tough 2 until the end of the Round.

knownIssues: No printed Impact value, unlike other Faction Leaders in this file (most list an explicit Impact bonus). Could be an intentional omission for a Spirit Leader without a melee Charge focus, or a drafting gap; not resolved here.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Spirit-themed generic Line Infantry, ranged spectral archers, Scouts, and conventional Support Units. Haunters serve as dedicated combat infiltrators, while generic Scouts remain a less expensive way to obtain target designation.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Keening Archers as the faction's Extra Core, a ranged Spirit unit reinforcing the incorporeal/magic identity rather than patching a weakness. Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Armored on the Grave Leviathan's Abyssal Grasp, Anti-Unique on the Pale Monarch's Crown of Sorrows).
